# PixiJS runtime

- Version: 7.4.3, ES module browser distribution.
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@7.4.3/dist/pixi.min.mjs
- License: MIT; unmodified upstream LICENSE is included beside the runtime.
- SHA-256: `a88e4607d95131552fee4cc2857487a354ffe2b4287400503c4b72113f9fcfe5`
- Loaded locally and lazily by `22-oc-renderer.js`; no runtime CDN requests.
- The role is transparent WebGL rendering of the independently authored Kanzei
  character pack. No Amadeus renderer implementation is included.
